name: Kyoto Experiment
name_ja: KYOTO EXPERIMENT 京都国際舞台芸術祭
underground_reason: Independent festival committee with a radical cross-genre programme; uses institutional venues but the fringe (More Experiments) is artist-run
foreigner_friendly_notes: Full English site; most shows subtitled or non-verbal; Festival Share Cafe after marked shows is a meeting point
notes: 2026 edition 3-25 Oct, so the first week is the last week. Post-show talks and the Share Cafe are the easiest way to meet the Kansai performing-arts crowd.

name: UrBANGUILD
name_ja: アバンギルド
address: New Kyoto Bldg 3F, Kiyamachi Sanjo-sagaru, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto
underground_reason: Artist-run 120-cap room since 2006; monthly FOuR DANCERS dance night, Butoh Night, free-improv and experimental touring acts; no-charge bar after shows
ticketing: door, reservation form on site for advance-priced nights
foreigner_friendly_notes: Listings in Japanese but lineups readable; +700 yen drink charge; bar stays open no-charge until 24:00 after events (best hang-out in Kyoto)
notes: The single most important Kyoto room for this client: dance nights (FOuR DANCERS has a reduced 'dancer' ticket), butoh, improv, ambient tours. Reserve via the site form; pay cash at door.

name: Kyoto Art Center
name_ja: 京都芸術センター
underground_reason: City-run former school; free studios for young companies (Monochrome Circus, ANTIBODIES Collective etc.), free Meirin workshops, KEX main venue
foreigner_friendly_notes: English site; free entry to building, library, cafe (11-18); workshops booked via teket form in Japanese
notes: Walk in any day: the studio-user list on the site is a who's-who of Kyoto dance. Meirin workshops are free and taught by resident artists; open calls (Co-program, KIPPU U35, studio residency) posted here.

name: Kyoto International Butoh Festival
name_ja: 京都国際舞踏祭
underground_reason: Artist-run (Katsura Kan & committee), 60+ dancers from 47 regions over 9 nights with live musicians; the kind of room where you meet every butoh person in Japan
foreigner_friendly_notes: Bilingual statement; many foreign dancers perform; contact kyotobutohfes@gmail.com (public festival address)
notes: 4th edition 7-15 Nov 2026. Pre-event 26 Oct at UrBANGUILD with open stage ('surprise guest appearances by festival dancers') is the networking night before the festival.

name: SPACE LFAN
underground_reason: Small private space hosting the 9-night butoh festival; little public info beyond that
notes: Only verified as the 2026 butoh festival venue. Near THEATRE E9 and @KCUA.

name: Monochrome Circus
name_ja: モノクローム・サーカス
underground_reason: Kyoto's contact-improvisation company (since 1990); runs CI workshops and jams at KAC and directs the Kyoto International Dance Workshop Festival
foreigner_friendly_notes: CI workshops are physical, not verbal; past KAC listings were Japanese-only but open to anyone
notes: The door into Kyoto contact improv. Watch KAC's Meirin Workshop page for their next CI jam; email the company (public address on their site) to ask about open classes.

name: Butoh company Kiraza (Ima Tenko)
name_ja: 舞踏カンパニー倚羅座 / 今貂子
underground_reason: Independent butoh company led by Ima Tenko; performs in small rooms (UrBANGUILD), KEX fringe participant
foreigner_friendly_notes: Site has English notes; performances non-verbal
notes: Ima Tenko performs MIZUMONO on 20 Oct and CIBELES on 30 Oct at UrBANGUILD. Ask at the bar after the show about workshops.

name: CLUB METRO
name_ja: クラブメトロ
underground_reason: Long-running basement club under a station with collective-run nights (ACTIVISM!!!, Sound Maneuvers x EXP, Deep Underground techno) alongside bands
foreigner_friendly_notes: Cash at door; ID may be checked at night
notes: Boro Festa's night session (31 Oct) with 食品まつり a.k.a foodman is the most experimental club night found in the window. Website not opened in this pass; use the e+ and kyoto.travel listings.

name: Boro Festa
name_ja: ボロフェスタ
underground_reason: Volunteer-run Kyoto indie festival; daytime hall stages are guitar-indie, the Metro night stage leans experimental (foodman, NATURE DANGER GANG)
foreigner_friendly_notes: e+ ticketing is Japanese-only; smartphone tickets
notes: 31 Oct-3 Nov 2026. Go for the Metro night, skip the hall unless you like Japanese indie rock.

name: @KCUA (Kyoto City University of Arts Gallery)
name_ja: 京都市立芸術大学ギャラリー@KCUA
underground_reason: University gallery with an experimental programme; hosts KEX exhibitions
foreigner_friendly_notes: Free; 10:00-18:00, closed Mondays
notes: Kaori Endo / Mithu Sen exhibition runs to 8 Nov. The art-school crowd hangs around here and HAPS.

name: ROHM Theatre Kyoto
name_ja: ロームシアター京都
underground_reason: Public theatre; include only for KEX and the 'Hopes' repertory premieres and the U35 KIPPU programme
foreigner_friendly_notes: English site
notes: Institutional. Worth it for 'Hopes' repertory (30 Oct-1 Nov, 6-8 Nov) and as KEX venue; otherwise skip.

name: THEATRE E9 KYOTO
name_ja: シアターE9京都
underground_reason: Crowdfunded independent black box opened 2019; KEX venue; hosts Monochrome Circus and young companies
foreigner_friendly_notes: Office hours 10-18, closed Tue
notes: Listed as a 2026 KEX venue. Programme page not opened in this pass; check askyoto.or.jp/e9 weekly.

name: HAPS (Higashiyama Artists Placement Service)
name_ja: 東山 アーティスツ・プレイスメント・サービス
underground_reason: Artist-support office run by artists for artists: free consultation desk, studio/space listings, open-call digest, and 'Enjoy Exhibition Club' group gallery walks
foreigner_friendly_notes: English page; consultation by form
notes: Best first stop for a foreign artist who wants to meet Kyoto people: ask for a consultation slot and join the next Enjoy Exhibition Club walk (#14 announced 16 Oct).

name: Kyoto International Dance Workshop Festival (Kyoto no Atsui Natsu)
name_ja: 京都国際ダンスワークショップフェスティバル「京都の暑い夏」
underground_reason: 30-year-old workshop festival run by Dance & Environment / Monochrome Circus with KAC; international teachers, CI and improv strands, open enrolment
foreigner_friendly_notes: International faculty; classes taught in English/Japanese
notes: 2026: early-summer edition 2-6 May, main edition 1-9 Aug. Not in the window; put it in the client's calendar for 2027.

name: DANCE BOX / ArtTheater dB Kobe
name_ja: NPO法人DANCE BOX／アートシアターdB神戸
underground_reason: NPO-run 120-seat dance theatre in a shopping arcade; 8-month 'domestic dance study abroad' residency, open classes, AIR, butoh seasons
foreigner_friendly_notes: Japanese site; AIR programme hosts foreign artists so staff are used to English
notes: Day trip - Kobe: 1h from Kyoto by train. The most dancer-dense community in Kansai; the Nov 16-18 intensive is an 'open class' tagged event.

name: Kyoto Art Box
name_ja: 京都文化芸術オフィシャルサイト Kyoto Art Box
underground_reason: City-run listing; mostly institutions but small organisers (butoh festival) post here too
notes: Filter by ダンス/音楽 and 公演/ワークショップ. Low signal-to-noise but structured dates.

name: Kyoto City Tourism 'Night events' listing (ja.kyoto.travel)
name_ja: 京都観光Navi 夜観光イベント一覧
underground_reason: Tourism-board page, but it mirrors Club Metro and UrBANGUILD nights with dates
notes: Useful only as a cross-check of Metro/UrBANGUILD dates.

name: KYOTOGRAPHIE / KYOTOPHONIE / KG+
underground_reason: Large international photo festival; KG+ satellite programme is where emerging artists show in small spaces
notes: Spring (kick-off party 18 Apr 2026 at Club Metro). Not in window; festival calendar only. Verified via listing snippet only.

name: Kyoto Art Theater Shunjuza
name_ja: 京都芸術劇場 春秋座
underground_reason: University theatre; relevant as a KEX venue
notes: Only verified as a 2026 KEX venue.

name: Ftarri
name_ja: Ftarri（水道橋）
address: Okano Bldg B1F, 1-4-11 Hongo, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo 113-0033
underground_reason: Label-run 20-seat basement shop/venue; nightly improvised and experimental concerts with visiting European players
ticketing: email reservation (info@ftarri.com); walk-in +1000 yen if space
foreigner_friendly_notes: English schedule; reserve by email with name, date, number; cash only; BYO drinks allowed; no smoking
notes: Concerts 20:00 (doors 19:30), 2000-4000 yen. With 20 seats you will talk to the musicians. Best Tokyo entry point for experimental music.

name: FORESTLIMIT
name_ja: 幡ヶ谷フォレストリミット
underground_reason: Independently run basement where collectives (Massacre series, nannou, experienc(e), Sustain) throw live/DJ nights; also hosts small exhibitions
ticketing: door (+1 drink), some adv via DM/form
foreigner_friendly_notes: Lineups in roman letters; 2000-3500 yen + drink; many nights run 22:00-05:00
notes: Ambient/experimental artists like yolabmi and Sofheso play here. Weeknight shows start ~18:30-19:00; weekend parties are all-nighters. Check event page for each lineup.

name: Kagurazaka Session House
name_ja: 神楽坂セッションハウス
underground_reason: Independent dance house since 1991: weekday open classes (ballet, contemporary, somatic), weekend studio-theatre showcases (Dance Theater 21 Fes, D-Zone), Gaga workshops
ticketing: reserve.html form, teket, livepocket, zaiko stream
foreigner_friendly_notes: English site; classes booked via Airreserve calendar or phone; drop-in classes exist
notes: The place to take class in Tokyo and to see 10-minute pieces by local dancers (21 Fes). Also runs open calls (21 Fes slots open 4 Nov; Dzone 2027 deadline 31 Oct).

name: Tokyo Festival / Autumn Meteorite 2026 Tokyo
name_ja: 東京舞台芸術祭 舞台芸術祭「秋の隕石2026東京」
underground_reason: Public festival directed by Toshiki Okada with a sharp international programme (Beugré, Ahe Engineering Theatre); institutional venue
ticketing: Tokyo Metropolitan Theatre box office, pia, eplus
foreigner_friendly_notes: Japanese/English surtitles on most shows; U29 3000 yen tickets
notes: 9 Oct-3 Nov 2026. 'Next: look, talk' residency (22 Oct-2 Nov) brings young international makers to town - good people to meet at post-show talks.

name: Tokyo Metropolitan Theatre
name_ja: 東京芸術劇場
underground_reason: Public theatre; only relevant while it hosts Autumn Meteorite under Okada
foreigner_friendly_notes: English site and box office
notes: Venue row for festival events only.

name: Art Center Ongoing
name_ja: アートセンター・オンゴーイング
underground_reason: Artist-run gallery with a cafe/bar and artist library; residency; talks and live events; the Kichijoji art crowd's living room
foreigner_friendly_notes: English page; open Wed-Thu 18-21, Fri-Sun 12-21
notes: Go on a Friday evening, sit at the bar. Exhibition 'Figure Children' by Yoshinori Kawamoto runs 21 Oct-1 Nov.

name: BUoY Arts Center Tokyo
name_ja: 北千住BUoY
underground_reason: Artist-run centre in a derelict bowling alley/bathhouse; hosts performance collectives (RAW PARTY), dance, experimental music and its own NAFAS festival
foreigner_friendly_notes: Japanese site; cafe on site; 6 min from Kita-Senju station
notes: East-side anchor. RAW PARTY nights include an 'independent' open slot for anyone who wants to perform.

name: RAW PARTY (牢)
name_ja: 『牢／RAW PARTY』
underground_reason: Performance-art collective night at BUoY with an 'indépendants' open section for anyone to join
foreigner_friendly_notes: Instagram only; performers include Aokid and other dance/performance names
notes: vol.5 was 10 Oct 2026; next date not announced. Follow the Instagram and DM to join the open section.

name: SUPER DOMMUNE
name_ja: スーパードミューン
underground_reason: Ukawa Naohiro's streaming studio; nightly DJ/live/talk programmes with limited studio audiences; curatorially extreme, physically a Parco floor
ticketing: free streams; some studio-audience nights ticketed
foreigner_friendly_notes: Talk programmes are in Japanese; DJ nights (BROADJ) need no language
notes: Moved to Shibuya PARCO 9F. Use it as a scanner of who is in town (touring DJs stream here before club dates) rather than as a venue.

name: Higashi-Koenji Nijuuman Denatsu (20000V)
name_ja: 東高円寺二万電圧
address: L-GRAZIA Higashi-Koenji B1, 1-7-23 Koenji-Minami, Suginami-ku, Tokyo
underground_reason: Small DIY live house (16 years in Oct 2026) but recent bookings skew to visual-kei/idol nights; check each lineup
foreigner_friendly_notes: Japanese-only listings
notes: Keep in DB but demoted: programme in 2026 is mostly not experimental. Official site not opened in this pass.

name: Nishiogikubo Contact Improvisation WS & Jam
name_ja: コンタクトインプロビゼーションWs＆Jam 西荻窪
address: Izumida Ballet Studio, 4-2-1 Kamiogi, Suginami-ku, Tokyo
underground_reason: Volunteer-run CI class + jam twice a month; 500-1500 yen; no booking; explicit English welcome
foreigner_friendly_notes: English description on page; first-timers free on 1st Saturdays; contact nishiogici@gmail.com (public) or Facebook
notes: 1st Sat: 14:00 class, 15:30-18:00 jam; 3rd Sat: 14:00-18:00. Page is undated - confirm on Facebook before going (status left blank).

name: Dairakudakan / Kochuten
name_ja: 大駱駝艦・壺中天
underground_reason: Maro Akaji's butoh company (since 1972); Kochuten studio series lets company members direct small-scale works
foreigner_friendly_notes: Non-verbal; company site not opened in this pass
notes: No Tokyo dates found inside the window (their 2026 Kobe butoh season was at Dance Box). Ask about Kochuten studio workshops.

name: MIMINOIMI Ambient Week
name_ja: MIMINOIMI - Ambient / Week
underground_reason: Organiser collective (with 'TENbient') running a yearly week of ambient/drone concerts, talks and workshops across small Tokyo rooms and DOMMUNE
foreigner_friendly_notes: Music is non-verbal; talks in Japanese
notes: 2026 edition was in May (Day 5 on DOMMUNE 8 May). Directly matches the client's ambient taste; nothing in the window, but the network (Ayami Suzuki, soma hayato, Ken Ikeda) plays Ftarri and Forestlimit all year.

name: Art Week Tokyo
underground_reason: Art Basel-backed gallery week; mainstream institutions, but 55 galleries open free and the AWT Bar is where the whole art scene drinks for five nights
foreigner_friendly_notes: Fully English
notes: 4-8 Nov 2026 (overlaps the client's last Tokyo days). Dates verified on secondary sources only; official site not opened.

name: Tokyo Art Beat
underground_reason: Bilingual listing covering museums down to artist-run spaces (BUoY events appear here)
notes: Media partner of Autumn Meteorite. Filter 'performance' and 'opening reception' tags.

name: Tokyo Gig Guide
underground_reason: Community-run English gig listing; Ftarri posts its whole schedule here with 'experimental/improvised' tags
notes: Filter categories Experimental / Avant garde / Ambient. Structured date, venue and price fields.

name: Resident Advisor (Tokyo / Kansai)
underground_reason: Standard club listing; small collective nights at Forestlimit, Bonobo, VENT are listed here with tickets
notes: Event index not opened in this pass (fetch limit). Use ra.co/events/jp/tokyo weekly.

name: SuperDeluxe
name_ja: スーパー・デラックス
underground_reason: Was the city's avant-garde salon; closed for building works
notes: CLOSED mid-January 2019. Do not send anyone here.

name: 3331 Arts Chiyoda
name_ja: アーツ千代田3331
underground_reason: Former artist-run centre in a school; closed
notes: CLOSED 31 March 2023. The AIR 3331 residency continued separately (not verified in 2026).

name: Youkobo Art Space
name_ja: 遊工房アートスペース
underground_reason: Long-running family-run AIR with studios and critique sessions; site live but no dated 2026 activity found
foreigner_friendly_notes: English site; residency takes foreign artists
notes: Status left blank: site is live but no dated event was visible on the pages opened. Verify by email before relying on it.

name: Theater Commons Tokyo
name_ja: シアターコモンズ
underground_reason: Independent festival run by Arts Commons Tokyo with partner cultural institutes; experimental, lecture-format and site-based performance outside theatres
foreigner_friendly_notes: English site
notes: 10th edition ran 22 Feb-8 Mar 2026 (Translating Commons). Not in the client's window; put it in the calendar for early 2027. Added for the curators link (Chiaki Soma).
